summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on the accuracy and handling of `facility_master_num` in data tables. A concern was raised that the number sometimes incorrectly assigned a cluster facility ID to an outdoor screen.

It was suggested that recalculating models for past periods, excluding subsequent cluster changes, might be necessary. One suggestion was made to make `facility_master_num` calculated and time-dependent within sessions.

Later in the session, there was a brief technical check performed on the database connection (ClickHouse), which required restarting.
decisions: Investigate making facility_master_num calculated and time-dependent for sessions.
action_items: Update and test the calculation of facility_master_num to assess complexity/overhead.
